FIRE SERVICES ACT 1988

FIRE SERVICES (DESIGNATED PREMISES) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2020

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 27 of the

Fire Services Act 1988 [Act 341], the Director General makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Fire Services (Designated Premises)

(Amendment) Order 2020.

Substitution of Schedule

2. The Fire Services (Designated Premises) Order 1998 [P.U. (A) 276/1998]

is amended by substituting for the Schedule the following schedule:
